title: Bank transaction ledger with expandable detail rows and category selects
notes: v2 is a Vue rewrite (scoped data-v attributes, renamed classes): transactions are grouped into one tbody per day with a day-heading row (the Date column disappears) and ordered chronologically inside each day, the expand toggle moves to the first column with an sr-only 'Toggle details' label, Paid in/Paid out become Money in/Money out in swapped order, detail rows get hashed ids and 'Report a problem' replaces 'Dispute this transaction', the category selects get optgroups, a 'Pending' table repeats a TfL payment, and search + export move into an <lb-ledger-toolbar> shadow root with a hidden export menu duplicating 'Export CSV'.

targets.description: Icon-only expand/collapse toggle of the 30 Oct 'Tesco Stores 3214' transaction (£48.37)
Category <select> of the 30 Oct 'TfL Travel Charge' transaction
'Paid out' amount cell of the 29 Oct Amazon Marketplace transaction (£42.99)
'Dispute this transaction' button in the expanded detail row of the 25 Oct Sainsbury's payment (v2: 'Report a problem')
Download-as-CSV link of the transaction list (v2: 'Export CSV' in the ledger toolbar)
'Search transactions' text input above the ledger
